env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

mkdir $WORK/orig
cp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo
cp go.mod $WORK/orig/go.mod

logos build .
logos lint .
logos context 'example.com/readonly#Main'
logos eject -o out
logos test ./...
logos vet ./...
logos list ./...
logos run .
! logos lsp unexpected-arg
stderr 'unexpected argument'
mkdir $WORK/fixorig
cp fixable/main.lgo $WORK/fixorig/main.lgo
cd fixable
! logos lint .
stderr '\[slop::discarded_error\]'
cmp main.lgo $WORK/fixorig/main.lgo
cd ..

mkdir $WORK/origgo
cp goapp/main.go $WORK/origgo/main.go
cd goapp
logos next
cmp main.go $WORK/origgo/main.go
! exists next_tasks.json
cd ..

cmp main.lgo $WORK/orig/main.lgo
cmp go.mod $WORK/orig/go.mod
exists out/main.go

-- goapp/go.mod --
module example.com/goapp

go 1.27

-- goapp/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func double(xs []int) []int {
	var ys []int
	for i := range xs {
		ys = append(ys, 2*xs[i])
	}
	return ys
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(double([]int{1, 2, 3}))
}

-- go.mod --
module example.com/readonly

go 1.27

-- main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func Main() string { return "unchanged" }

func main() { fmt.Println(Main()) }

-- fixable/go.mod --
module example.com/fixable

go 1.27

-- fixable/main.lgo --
package main

import "os"

func main() {
	os.Remove("missing")
}
